request: For a linked worktree, look for .git/info/exclude only in that worktree's own git dir and stop following commondir, so each checkout has independent exclusions.

source.request: For a linked worktree, look for .git/info/exclude only in that worktree's own git dir and stop following commondir, so each checkout has independent exclusions.
source.settled: Linked worktrees locate the shared info/exclude file through the git directory's commondir file.
source.why: Restricting lookup to the per-worktree git directory loses the shared exclusions the ticket made available.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
